intro x
let S := LieSubalgebra.engel K x
have hS : LieSubalgebra K S := LieSubalgebra.of_closure (by apply_instance)
let L' := ↥(LieSubalgebra.engel K x)
let L'' : Type u_8 := underlying L'
let i : L' →ₗ[K] L'' := LinearMap.id
let f : L'' →ₗ[K] L'' := LinearMap.id
let ad_x : L →ₗ[K] L := LieAlgebra.ad K L x
let ad_x_restrict : L' →ₗ[K] L'' := ad_x.restrict L'
let charpoly_ad_x_restrict := LinearMap.charpoly ad_x_restrict
let charpoly_ad_x := LinearMap.charpoly ad_x
let h_charpoly : charpoly_ad_x_restrict = charpoly_ad_x.comp (LinearMap.id : L' →ₗ[K] L) :=
  by rw [ad_x_restrict, LinearMap.charpoly_restrict]
let h_natTrailingDegree : charpoly_ad_x.natTrailingDegree = charpoly_ad_x_restrict.natTrailingDegree :=
  by rw h_charpoly
let h_dim : Module.finrank K L' = (charpoly_ad_x_restrict).natTrailingDegree :=
  by apply Module.finrank_eq_natTrailingDegree
rw h_natTrailingDegree at h_dim
exact h_dim
